players.product: Chinese OSAT (Tongfu Microelectronics) buying Hanmi packaging equipment

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 27.92 billion, up 16.92% YoY, which the company calls a record high; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1.22 billion, up 79.86%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 840.57 million, up 35.34%; operating cash flow RMB 6.97 billion, up 79.66%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 6.09 billion, Q2 RMB 6.95 billion, Q3 RMB 7.08 billion, Q4 RMB 7.81 billion; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 101.39 million, Q2 RMB 310.70 million, Q3 RMB 448.40 million, Q4 RMB 358.22 million (Q4 excluding non-recurring items RMB 62.57 million). The company attributes the growth to higher capacity utilization, a marked rise in mid-to-high-end product revenue, cost control and investment gains from its supply-chain investments.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue RMB 27.92 billion (+16.92%); net profit RMB 1.22 billion (+79.86%); Q4 revenue RMB 7.81 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, regions and volumes (annual report): IC packaging and test revenue RMB 27.25 billion in 2025, 97.59% of revenue, up 18.89%, gross margin 14.40% (down 0.10 points); molds and materials sales RMB 673.86 million (down 30.04%). Overseas revenue RMB 18.59 billion, 66.59% of revenue (up 17.95%); domestic revenue RMB 9.33 billion (up 14.92%); packaging and test gross margin 15.07% overseas and 13.02% domestic. IC packaging and test sales volume 4,565,413 ten-thousand units (up 21.13%), output 4,590,626 ten-thousand units (up 22.03%), year-end inventory 141,239 ten-thousand units. All sales are direct.
quarterly_data.figure: IC packaging and test revenue RMB 27.25 billion (+18.89%), gross margin 14.40%; sales volume 4,565,413 ten-thousand units (+21.13%)

quarterly_data.signal: Business lines in 2025 (annual report): in power management chips, deeper work with leading PMIC customers expanded its share and brought revenue growth in the hundreds of millions of RMB; the number of automotive customers doubled, with applications extending from control systems to smart cockpit and chassis control; memory-chip packaging revenue rose substantially YoY; in display drivers it won two leading customers, with double-digit output-value growth; its wafer-level packaging cooperates fully with leading domestic customers in audio and power-management chips. The company says that as AI compute demand surged it quickly opened the market for high-performance product packaging.
quarterly_data.figure: automotive customers doubled; display-driver output value double-digit growth

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging progress in 2025 (annual report): FCBGA ultra-large-size multi-chip co-packaging and extreme thermal-management solutions developed and in volume production; a high-stack memory packaging structure developed in support of customer product plans; thin-die hybrid SiP double-sided packaging capability established; TOLT and QDPAK top-side-cooling power packages developed and entering industrialization; IGBT 1800A ultra-high-current test technology in mass production. R&D in progress includes chiplet-based high-density packaging for high-performance computing chips and 5nm bumping (target package yield above 99.5%). Cumulative patent applications 1,779 at December 31, 2025 (about 70% invention patents), granted patents above 800; it holds technology licences from Fujitsu, Casio and AMD.
quarterly_data.figure: IGBT 1800A test in mass production; 5nm bumping target yield above 99.5%; 1,779 patent applications

quarterly_data.signal: Co-packaged optics (annual report): the company's CPO technology R&D made phased progress - its R&D products passed reliability testing and have entered the mass-production introduction stage.
R&D (annual report): R&D spend RMB 1.59 billion in 2025, up 3.85%, 5.70% of revenue (6.42% in 2024), none capitalized; R&D staff 2,510 (up 15.83%), 9.86% of employees.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 1.59 billion, 5.70% of revenue; 2,510 R&D staff

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers (annual report) were 69.54% of 2025 sales (RMB 19,415,946,510.56); the largest 52.29% (RMB 14,600,435,206.56), then 6.22%, 5.09%, 3.16% and 2.78%; names not disclosed; related-party share 0.00%.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 69.54% of 2025 sales; largest 52.29%

quarterly_data.figure: top five suppliers 24.21% of 2025 purchases; largest 5.42%

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business target (annual report): the company's 2026 revenue target is RMB 323.00 hundred million, up 15.68% on 2025, with economic benefit expected to grow in step; the company says the target is not a profit forecast and its achievement depends on market conditions and operations, with uncertainty. To support it, the company and its subsidiaries Nantong Tongfu, Tongfu Tongke, Hefei Tongfu, Xiamen Tongfu, TF-AMD Suzhou and TF-AMD Penang plan to invest a total of RMB 91 hundred million in 2026 in facilities, production equipment, IT and R&D. Strategy: strengthen core advanced-packaging technology, build important overseas bases in Southeast Asia, and pursue M&A.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 revenue target RMB 323.00 hundred million (+15.68%); 2026 investment plan RMB 91 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity build-out (annual report): construction in progress RMB 3,116,580,487.20 at end-2025 (RMB 3,678,955,175.22 a year earlier), mostly equipment being installed; fixed assets rose on mid-to-high-end production-line investment. Major projects: Sutong industrial park 56.60% of budget invested, phases 1 and 2 completed and phase 3 under construction; Penang new plant under construction (RMB 209,276,094.62 in construction in progress at year-end); Tongfu Suzhou construction 79.68% of budget invested, basic construction completed. In 2025 the Chongchuan, Nantong Tongfu, Tongfu Tongke, Xiamen Tongfu, TF-AMD Suzhou and TF-AMD Penang bases completed renovation of about 13 wan (ten-thousand) square meters cumulatively, and a 110KV substation project at Tongfu Tongke is under way. The raised-fund microcontroller (MCU) packaging and test project was 85.89% invested, scheduled ready for use in December 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress RMB 3,116,580,487.20; Sutong park 56.60% of budget invested

quarterly_data.signal: Subsidiaries in 2025 (annual report, RMB hundred million): TF-AMD Suzhou revenue 79.71, operating profit 11.14, net profit 9.93; TF-AMD Penang revenue 94.11, net profit 4.59; Nantong Tongfu revenue 26.79, net loss 3.74; Hefei Tongfu revenue 12.17; Tongfu Tongke revenue 15.98, net loss 0.80. The Suzhou and Penang plants posted record revenue and profit; Suzhou focuses on the domestic market and Penang on overseas markets. Xiamen Tongfu was consolidated from August 31, 2025 after the company bought a further 22.3334% stake.
quarterly_data.figure: TF-AMD Suzhou revenue RMB 79.71 hundred million; TF-AMD Penang revenue RMB 94.11 hundred million

connects_to.relationship: OSAT packaging and test supplier (TF-AMD Suzhou / Penang)

contracts.signal: Annual report: through its acquisition of 85% of AMD Suzhou and AMD Penang, the company and AMD formed a 'joint venture + cooperation' model and a close strategic partnership; the company states it is AMD's most important packaging and test supplier, handling over 80% of AMD's related products. In 2025 its TF-AMD Suzhou and TF-AMD Penang plants focused on packaging and test capability for AI and high-compute products and on 3nm advanced-process product development; Penang's 3nm multi-chip product packaging passed validation and its bumping and wafer test started production in October with yields well above the customer's expectations; Suzhou's large-size multi-chip indium-sheet product yield reached what the company calls an OSAT-leading level.
